card.name: Power and strength in geopolitics essays
card.fires_on: Words in geopolitics or economics commentary about national power, such as military, naval, economic or benefited, placed just before a noun like strength, capabilities or importance.

modes.label: Power adjectives
modes.description: An adjective such as military, naval or economic describing a state's strength or resources.
modes.example: economic strength wields greater power than<< military>> strength.

modes.label: Gain verbs
modes.description: A verb of gaining or thriving that follows a country or trend as subject.
modes.example: Modern China has<< benefited>> enormously from this arrangement
